workingTreeInstall.description: Dependencies are installed with npm from the committed package-lock.json into node_modules/ of the working tree, as a developer has them. The repository's .gitignore excludes node_modules/.
workingTreeInstall.projectItselfInstalled: no: class-validator is the project under test, not a dependency of itself; no npm link, no file: or link: dependency and no workspace link in node_modules/

evidenceWorkspace.description: node_modules/ is copied into each evidence workspace (C001-ADR-006 table, TypeScript/JavaScript row, item 3.1). The tests import the project from src/ through ts-jest with relative paths, so every project file loads from the workspace.

activeEnvironment.description: Any shell with Node.js >= 22 on PATH, started in the repository root; nothing is activated.

testCommandNotes: The project's own `npm test` is `jest --coverage --verbose`; the review collects its own per-test coverage, so the coverage flag is turned off in the command given to it. jest.config.js (preset ts-jest, tsconfig.spec.json) is the project's test configuration; no path of the working tree is put on an import path.
